author: architect-agent (Astra)

addressed: First-gate invalidation stops without replanning under the same grant; exact ordinary, shadow and probe outcomes are frozen
Native shadow S1 uses complete authenticated test failure exit 1; arbitrary exit 23 remains guard-level only
Guard observes preceding-phase quiescence/uncertainty before emitting ready
Setup frames use phase setup and attempt_id a001, separately from execution a001
Focused reproduction explicitly supersedes design section 9: ordinary caller-requested scoped evidence, no built-in replay/classifier
Four-file sensitivity/recovery uses full_ratio 0.75; separate equality case at 0.50 widens to full
Freeze per-mode a001 identity references; probe first content capture cannot prove admission-time content stability
Enumerate exactly five REASON_CODES additions with exact public/private use and unchanged decision-stop subset

t12a_repair_ownership.scope: Ownership-only correction to the narrower execution brief; all frozen runtime behavior, G1-G3/H1-H2 and ordered deliverables remain unchanged

fixture_files.why: Independent admission/controller cancellation must emit guard protocol 2; leave scheduler/domain protocol unchanged
Real-guard barriers, fake clock and bounded fault injection for decision, cancellation, deadline and quiescence evidence
Local child/descendant markers and IPC barriers for G1-G3, survivor uncertainty, cleanup and neighbor preservation
Protocol-2 operations fault injection must reach the intended wrong-run/nonce/order/handoff or first-gate boundary, not incidental protocol-1 rejection

t12a_repair_ownership.restored_selection_responsibility: Pure choose_shadow_plans and quarantine-aware ordinary fallback plus test_selection.py stay in T12a; no deferral or record-only completion
t12a_repair_ownership.other_boundaries: File-specific fixtures only; operations limited to shared transport/ordinary-run first gates; no other fixtures, adapters, CLI, source/config/scheduler or dependency/packaging transfer; existing report paths unchanged
t12a_repair_ownership.required_evidence: Real-subprocess G1-G3, H1-H2 marker/evidence preservation and operations first-gate regressions; scoped evidence across all five owned test modules without weakening assertions
t12a_repair_ownership.next_action: Controller corrects the implementation brief to transfer these exact files before repair resumes

ordered_deliverables.scope: Shared authenticated guard decision protocol, typed quarantine/history publication and pure diagnostic planning
ordered_deliverables.gate: Scoped G1-G3 and H1-H2 evidence, ordinary-run regressions, Opus contract approval

ordered_deliverables.scope: Actual advanced pytest/Vitest selection, verified runtime/baseline handoff and distinct supported parallel identities; ordinary single-attempt integration
ordered_deliverables.gate: Q-PY-SELECT, Q-PY-PROBE, Q-VT-SELECT and Q-VT-PROBE real native evidence plus Opus qualification approval

ordered_deliverables.scope: One-lease shadow/probe orchestration, exact grammar and truthful compound outcomes
ordered_deliverables.gate: S1-S3, P1-P3, C1-C2; both first-class bad-policy sensitivity cases, positive probes, Opus M3 gate and root-owned final integrated test gate

guard_protocol.before_ready: Guard reaps direct child and observes no live non-guard group member or live/unknown recorded escape; uncertainty closes spawning
guard_protocol.gates: Every execution attempt; no ungated fallback; EOF, stop, cancellation, timeout or invalid frames close subsequent spawning

identity_references.automatic_selected_and_shadow: Admitted plan input_digest or fixed selected/full comparison digest, plus bound config/scope/relevant environment resolution
identity_references.automatic_full_explicit_full_and_scoped: Retained post-admission pre-guard input/config/environment capture; scope matches admitted resolution; no earlier content-delta claim
identity_references.probe: Config/scope/relevant environment drift from admission resolution or unknown required identity; a001 is first content capture for later gates/final verification, not admission-time content-delta detection

first_gate_invalidation.ordinary_and_probe: Incomplete 70, ptest origin, changed-during-run for observed change against the mode-specific reference or unknown-input for unknown required identity
first_gate_invalidation.shadow: Not-run 2, ptest origin, unsupported-capability plus changed-during-run or unknown-input
first_gate_invalidation.replan: New caller invocation and fresh admission; automatic readmission is outside Task 12

reason_code_additions.public: Run reason for execution or compound expiry; affected attempt status/exit remains in AttemptResult; incomplete ptest-origin 70 absent earlier nonzero; not queue or decision expiry
reason_code_additions.private: Existing guard deadline problem and allowed attempt-decision stop reason for exhausted execution budget

reason_code_additions.public: Run reason for pending-gate watchdog expiry; incomplete ptest-origin 70 absent earlier nonzero
reason_code_additions.private: Guard/controller diagnostic only; not an allowed decision-stop reason, new event or synthetic facts for an unstarted attempt

reason_code_additions.public: History/selection limitation and automatic-full planning reason while the dedicated row exists; context for eligible diagnostic shadow
reason_code_additions.private: Exact SelectionQuarantine.code and history-owned row discriminator; not a guard stop reason or generic health marker

reason_code_additions.public: Run reason only for a complete passing probe sample; no safety or full-gate certification
reason_code_additions.private: Controller classification of authenticated complete evidence only; not a guard/bridge verdict or decision-stop reason

reason_code_additions.public: Run reason for conclusive serial-pass/reproducible-parallel-failure differential; preserve first failing runner outcome
reason_code_additions.private: Controller classification of authenticated differential evidence only; not a guard/bridge verdict or decision-stop reason

frozen_decisions.reason_catalog_boundaries: Exactly five public additions; existing reasons and seven-code decision-stop subset unchanged; internal comparison verdicts and private control-unavailable are not added; preserve safe public projection; no second catalog or public field/schema-version change

shadow.requires: Qualified advanced first-class profile and genuine nonempty strict selected plan with compatible complete baseline
shadow.ordinary_selected_failure: Full still executes; first nonzero remains
shadow.native_s1: Complete authenticated selected native test failure exit 1, then full exit 0 or 1, final exit 1
shadow.incomplete_full: Not a confirmed or inferred omitted-test miss; no promotion or quarantine clearing

history.storage: Dedicated typed selector row under the existing history writer lock and transaction
history.recovery: Newer successful explicit eligible comparison, changed policy or compatibility, compatible clean full baseline after correction, exact expected-row match
history.unrelated_health_markers: Never removed or reset by comparison
history.compound_failures: Union of all attempt failures survives later same-compound passes

probe.qualification_required: First-class supported parallel worker identity and explicit run-worker-namespaced local isolation
probe.insufficient_workers: Exit 2/capacity-exceeded; blocked parallel portion, no serial-only success substitute
probe.unqualified: Exit 2/unsupported-capability, no launch; rejection alone does not complete probes

frozen_decisions.post_admission_rejection: Authenticated cancel_pending before registration; owned guard cancellation and proof/finalization after registration; never abandon a grant
frozen_decisions.product_scope: Local-first only; no remote execution, cloud operations, model calls, live installation, deployment or publication

verification.reason: Documentation-only instruction; no tests, dependency installation or runtime edits are authorized
verification.commit_scope: Only the three declared documentation/artifact files; supplied untracked brief remains untouched

next_gate: Controller verifies the required Opus documentation repairs before implementation consumes the shared contracts
